summary: GRI 406 addresses non-discrimination, defined as treating people unequally by imposing unequal burdens or denying benefits instead of treating each person fairly on individual merit. Discrimination can include harassment. It contains one disclosure on incidents and corrective actions.

questions.text: Describe the actual and potential, negative and positive impacts of the organization on the economy, environment and people, including impacts on their human rights, in relation to non-discrimination.
questions.hint: Cover both actual and potential impacts, negative and positive, including impacts on human rights.

questions.text: Is the organization involved with the negative impacts related to non-discrimination through its own activities or as a result of its business relationships? Describe those activities or business relationships.
questions.hint: State whether involvement is through the organization's activities or through its business relationships, and describe them.

questions.text: Describe the organization's policies or commitments regarding non-discrimination.
questions.hint: Describe the policies or commitments that apply to this material topic.

questions.text: Describe the actions taken to manage non-discrimination and the related impacts, including (i) actions to prevent or mitigate potential negative impacts, (ii) actions to address actual negative impacts, including actions to provide for or cooperate in their remediation, and (iii) actions to manage actual and potential positive impacts.
questions.hint: Cover i. prevention or mitigation of potential negative impacts; ii. addressing actual negative impacts, including remediation; iii. managing positive impacts.

questions.text: How does the organization track the effectiveness of the actions taken? Describe (i) the processes used, (ii) the goals, targets and indicators used to evaluate progress, (iii) the effectiveness of the actions, including progress toward goals and targets, and (iv) lessons learned and how they have been incorporated into operational policies and procedures.
questions.hint: Cover i. tracking processes; ii. goals, targets and indicators; iii. effectiveness and progress; iv. lessons learned and how they were incorporated.

questions.text: Describe how engagement with stakeholders has informed the actions taken (3-3-d) and how it has informed whether the actions have been effective (3-3-e).
questions.hint: Explain the role of stakeholder engagement in shaping actions and in judging their effectiveness.

disclosures.title: Incidents of discrimination and corrective actions taken

questions.text: What was the total number of incidents of discrimination during the reporting period?
questions.hint: Include discrimination on grounds of race, color, sex, religion, political opinion, national extraction or social origin, and other relevant forms.

questions.text: What is the status of the incidents and actions taken: (i) incident reviewed by the organization, (ii) remediation plans being implemented, (iii) remediation plans that have been implemented, with results reviewed through routine internal management review processes, (iv) incident no longer subject to action?
questions.hint: Report the status for each of i to iv.
